title.narrative: 2.4. Training of key users in beneficiary institutions
Indicators: - Users' manual and training materials in Arabic and English. - Some 50 staff in the beneficiary administrations are trained in the use of the central migration data management solution.
3. Stronger interagency cooperation and capacities in migration data management and analysis
Indicator: - Sample policy product drafted by the IWG

target.value: Enhanced interagency cooperation and capacities in migration data management and analysis

actual.value: At least four meetings of the IWG to discuss the cooperation in migration data management and analysis. - One formulated and agreed upon SOP’s document. - At least one sample policy product drafted cooperatively by the IWG.

title.narrative: 4. Closing phase: The project stakeholders have ownership of the operation of the central migration data management solution and itneragency cooperation on migration data collection, management and exchange
Indicators: - Database user statistics. - Agreement by the IWG members to continue their meetings beyond the project duration, presented during the last PSG meeting.

target.value: The project stakeholders have ownership of the operation of the central migration data management solution and the development of interagency cooperation on migration data collection, management and exchange.

actual.value: By the end of the project, the IWG has prepared and agreed on meetings’ schedule that extends beyond the project duration

title.narrative: 1. The inception phase: Agreement by the Jordanian stakeholders on the architecture of the future national migration data management solution, the objectives of the project, and the creation of an IWG on migration data management

Indicators: - PSG conclusions confirming the stakeholders' agreement. - Steady levels of representation and active participation of stakeholders in project activities documented in activity reports and lists of participants.

target.value: Agreed concept for a central migration data management solution

actual.value: Data migration assessment study report was developed, and findings approved by the IWG and the PSG members. - Three Focus Group Discussions were conducted with stakeholders to map their data development needs and capacities. - Meetings were conducted with IWG and PSG members to present the assessment report, receive feedback and amend accordingly. - A ToR was developed to hire a Data Solution Architect/ IT Data Technical Expert

title.narrative: 4.3. Closure of the project

Indicators: - Final project report including an assessment report and a summary of the project evaluation report, good practices. lessons learnt, and recommendations for the future. - Meeting minutes of the final PSG meeting.

actual.value: Final PSG meeting The final PSG meeting was conducted on 6 December 2021 (Annex 36 – Final PSG Meeting Minutes), to discuss the pilot of the migration data system, the challenges facing data collection process and discussing the arrangements for the “Lessons Learned” conference.

title.narrative: 2. A national migration data management solution is in place and staff is fully apt in its use
Indicator: - Database user reports.

target.value: A national migration data management solution is in place and staff are fully apt in its use.

title.narrative: 2.1. Procurement and purchase of database hardware (if required), software (incl. licenses) and related IT services, and subsequent installation of required IT infrastructure
Indicators: - Procurement notice. - Purchase documentation. - Installed hard- and software.

target.value: The required IT environment has been set up and is operational.

actual.value: The market research was conducted and finalized. - Technical specifications and terms of reference were developed based on the technical assessment study. - The procurement notice development is in progress. - The tender dossier development is in progress. - Appointment of Procurement Project Team (PTT) is in progress. - Official communication between MoI and MOPIC to appoint governmental representatives of the PPT and the technical evaluation committee is in progress

title.narrative: 2.3. Building and testing of the central migration data management solution
Indicators: - The migration data management solution is set up. - Test reports. - User acceptance tests.

actual.value: The migration management solution was set up. - Test reports were executed

title.narrative: 1.2. Development of a concept for a data solution architecture

Indicators: - Concept for a solution architecture. - Proposals for a user interface and format templates, as well as access rights levels. - Advice on the required software and hardware to be used. - An assessment of the workload related to the data consolidation process. - Technical specifications for procurement tenders.

actual.value: Concept for solution architecture, proposals for a user interface and format templates as well as access rights’ levels were identified, signed by the IWG members in the assessment report outcomes. - Recommendations on the required software and hardware to be used was finalized and agreed upon the in Infrastructure Technical Assessment Report. - An assessment of the workload of the data consolidation process was provided within the Infrastructure Technical Assessment Report. - Technical specifications for procurement tenders were developed.

title.narrative: 1.1. Assessment of Jordan's migration data system
Indicators: - Number of meetings held for consultations with project stakeholders. - Assessment report.

actual.value: Data migration assessment study report was developed, and findings approved by the IWG and the PSG members. - Three Focus Group Discussions were conducted with stakeholders to map their data development needs and capacities. - Meetings were conducted with IWG and PSG members to present the assessment report, receive feedback and amend accordingly. - A ToR was developed to hire a Data Solution Architect/ IT Data Technical Expert.

title.narrative: 1.3. Agreement on the design of a central migration data mangement solution, the project's objectives and the creation of an IWG

Indicators: - Project implementation roadmap. - Monitoring and evaluation framework. - Project inception report for the donor. - PSG conclusions related to stakeholders' approval. - Meeting minutes of the PSG meeting. - List of project counterparts, including IT officials and designated members of the IWG with their respective roles and responsibilities.

target.value: Agreement on the concept for a central migration data management solution and the composition of the IWG.

actual.value: Interagency working group (IWG) is officially formed of each beneficiary Jordanian administration using and/or producing the migration data in Jordan. - Project implementation roadmap was developed. - Monitoring and evaluation framework was completed. - Project inception report was submitted to the donor - PSG meetings were conducted to discuss the project activities and progress. - Technical team was formed of IT staff in each beneficiary administration who worked on the technical aspects of the data consolidation. - The IWG and PSG agreed on the concept for a central migration data management solution. - IWG and PSG discussed and approved the (project objectives and roadmap

title.narrative: 4.1. Assessment of stakeholders' satisfaction with project deliverables

Indicators: - At least 20 one-on-one interviews with the project participants representing a project beneficiaries. - Assessment report as part of the final project report. - Meetings schedule of the IWG beyond the project duration.

actual.value: Ten one-to-one interviews were conducted with participants representing project benificaries. - Assessment report contaning the results of the interviews was developed. - Meetings’ schedule of the IWG beyond the project duration was shared with MIDAM team.

title.narrative: 4.2. Evaluation of the project achievements
Indicator: - Project evaluation report.

target.value: The project's achievements have been thoroughly evaluated.

actual.value: The final project report was developed including : an assessment report, summery of the project evaluation report, good practices, lessons learnt and recommendations for the future. - The final PSG meeting was conducted and attended by MoI Secretary General.

title.narrative: 3.1. SOP for improved interagency cooperation in migration data management and analysis
Indicator: - Reports of the three SOP workshops. - Agreed SOP document.

actual.value: Two SOP workshops were conducted. - One agreed upon SOP document was developed.

title.narrative: 3.2. Joint policy-making on the basis of migration data retrieved from the central migration data management solution has been piloted
Indicators: - Three workshop reports. - Sample policy product.

target.value: Joint migration data analysis and policy formulation.

actual.value: Two data anaysis workshops were conducted. - One agreed sample policy product was developed.

title.narrative: 2.2. Planning and preparations for a central migration data management solution

Indicators: - Minutes of two planning workshops with IT staff and the IWG. - Agreement on access rights for the different administrations. - Data consolidation plan. - Operational concept for the central migration data management solution. - Training plan. - User acceptance tests. - Internal communications plan.

target.value: Planning activities and preparations are concluded.

actual.value: Two planning workshops were conducted, one with the IT staff and one the IWG. - Access rights document was developed and agreed upon. - Data consolidation plan was developed. User acceptance tests were developed. - The internal communication plan was drafted and discussed.
